# Tall Fenn: Art Vending Machine

Machine-readable guide for agents. Human page: https://tallfenn-art-vending.petrasynthetic.workers.dev

## Network

- Chain: Arc mainnet, chainId 5042
- RPC: https://rpc.mainnet.arc.io (fallbacks: https://rpc.blockdaemon.mainnet.arc.io, https://rpc.quicknode.mainnet.arc.io)
- Gas token: USDC (native, 18 decimals). Transfers through the ERC-20 interface use 6 decimals.
- USDC ERC-20: 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000
- Explorer: https://explorer.arc.io

## Contract

ArtVendor (v4): 0x1d9e2dd8cb1a709c75e04278b58945a25a5677c0

Artworks on sale:

| id | seedInput | price | editions |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | masas\|genesis\|001 | 0.5 USDC | 25 |
| 1 | masas\|premium\|003 | 2 USDC | 5 |
| 2 | masas\|premium\|011 | 5 USDC | 3 |

Seeds starting with `masas|premium|` render the premium look: an orbital sculpture with two light directions, double fresnel, light veins and suspended dust.

Relevant functions:

```
artworks(uint256 artworkId) view returns (
  address artist, uint256 price, uint32 editions, uint32 sold,
  string seedInput, bytes32 seedHash, string seriesName,
  address[] recipients, uint16[] sharesBps
)
artworkCount() view returns (uint256)
soldOf(uint256 artworkId) view returns (uint32)
buy(uint256 artworkId)
tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) view returns (string)
ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) view returns (address)
```

Events:

```
ArtworkSold(uint256 indexed artworkId, address indexed buyer, uint32 editionNumber, uint256 price, uint256 tokenId)
PayoutSent(uint256 indexed artworkId, address indexed recipient, uint256 amount)
```

## How an agent buys

1. Read the artwork: `price` is in USDC ERC-20 units (6 decimals). Check `sold < editions`.
2. Approve: `USDC.approve(ArtVendor, price)`.
3. Buy: `ArtVendor.buy(artworkId)`. The contract splits the payment to the recipients instantly and mints one receipt NFT to the caller.
4. Verify: `ownerOf(tokenId) == your address`, and decode `tokenURI(tokenId)` (base64 JSON) to read the seed hash, edition, image and animation_url.

A ready-to-run script lives in the repo: `scripts/agent-buy.mjs` (viem, Node 20+).

```
AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY=0x... ARTWORK_ID=0 node scripts/agent-buy.mjs
```

## The artwork is deterministic

Each piece derives from a seed string stored onchain:

```
seedHash = sha256(seedInput + "|v1|tallfenn")
```

The live render for a given piece is at `https://tallfenn-art-vending.petrasynthetic.workers.dev/live?h=<seedHash without 0x>`. The static poster is at `/posters/<seedHash without 0x>.png`. Same seed, same piece, on any device.

## Assets

- Seed study (not for sale): 12 seeds rendered at https://tallfenn-art-vending.petrasynthetic.workers.dev (Seeds page).
- Receipts: ERC-721 on Arc mainnet, name "Tall Fenn Receipt", symbol TFENN.
